title: Sloe Dumplings
description: A unique keto dessert combining the flavors of sloe and berries in a dumpling.

ingredients.name: Mixed Beries
ingredients.notes: Choose low-carb, keto-friendly options like strawberries or raspberries

ingredients.name: Yummy Whipped Cream
ingredients.notes: Keto-friendly whipped cream made with heavy cream and a sweetener like stevia

instructions: Wrap each dumpling wrapper around a small spoonful of sloe jam.
Place the dumplings on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 12-15 minutes or until golden brown.
While the dumplings are baking, whip the heavy cream with a sweetener like stevia until stiff peaks form.
Fold the whipped cream into the mixed berries.
To assemble the dessert, place a baked dumpling on a plate and top with a spoonful of the berry mixture and a few silky chocolate chips.
